Architectural Pillars

Engineered for Radical Transparency

Replacing opaque bureau black-boxes with deterministic mathematical rigor, explainable AI, and ethical fairness auditing.

01 // SYNTHESIZER ⚡

Informal Income Synthesizer

Reconstructs true recurring earnings from fragmented UPI and cash streams. Automatically filters internal transfers and isolates net operating surplus from gross receipts.

Time-Series Aggregation Learn more →
02 // 0-100 INDEX 📊

Deterministic Financial Health Score

A reproducible, auditable composite index across 5 objective pillars: Cashflow Surplus (30%), Income Consistency (25%), Debt Burden (20%), Reserve Buffer (15%), and Coverage (10%).

100% Deterministic Learn more →
03 // SHAP TRANSPARENCY 🔍

Grounded SHAP Feature Attribution

Demystifies the credit-risk model output. Inspect exact positive and negative feature contributions in log-odds space using exact TreeExplainer mathematical formulations.

Zero Hallucination Learn more →
04 // ETHICAL AI 🛡️

Fairlearn Model Bias Auditor

Continuous algorithmic governance tracking Demographic Parity Difference and Equalized Odds across gender, geography, and business archetypes to prevent systemic bias.

Audited & Verified Learn more →
05 // SANDBOX 🔄

What-If Financial Sandbox

An isolated scenario simulator letting borrowers model the score impact of trimming business expenses or expanding weekly digital sales without mutating baseline records.

Zero Mutation Learn more →
06 // VERIFIABLE DOSSIER 📄

Digital Financial Passport

Export an applicant-owned, tamper-evident PDF dossier with complete cashflow evidence, SHAP transparency, and SHA-256 verification hash to present to lenders.

PDF Export Learn more →
